traces.title: Both empty
traces.description: Empty against empty: score 0 and exactly one (empty) alignment.

traces.title: One empty affine
traces.description: Empty against ACG is one gap of length 3: open + 2 * extend.

traces.title: Homopolymer ties
traces.description: AAA vs AA: the single gap can sit in any of three places, giving three co-optimal alignments.

traces.title: Adjacent opposite gaps
traces.description: With a harsh mismatch, A vs C is best as two adjacent gaps of different kinds, in either order.

traces.title: Textbook gattaca
traces.description: The GATTACA / GCATGCU teaching example with +1 / -1 / -1 scoring.

traces.title: Affine merges gap
traces.description: Affine scoring should delete the TTTT block as one gap rather than scattering it.

traces.title: Durbin blosum50 linear
traces.description: HEAGAWGHEE / PAWHEAE, the worked example in Durbin et al. (1998), with BLOSUM50 and linear gap -8.

traces.title: Blosum62 affine
traces.description: Same peptides with BLOSUM62 and BLAST-style affine gaps (open -11, extend -1).

traces.title: DNA with one 3 bp deletion
traces.description: Two 30-ish bp sequences differing by substitutions and a single 3 bp deletion; affine gaps keep the deletion in one block.

traces.title: Homopolymer: many co-optimal alignments
traces.description: A run of A's against a shorter run. Every placement of the gap scores the same, so the optimal-path band fills a whole region of the table.

traces.title: Protein fragments, BLOSUM62
traces.description: A protein fragment against a variant with two substitutions (I/L, F/W) and a 3-residue deletion, scored with BLOSUM62 and BLAST-style affine gaps (open -11, extend -1).

traces.title: RNA: too short to pair
traces.description: Four bases cannot enclose a 3-base loop, so nothing pairs.

traces.title: RNA: simple hairpin
traces.description: A three-pair stem closing a three-base loop.

traces.title: RNA: no loop constraint
traces.description: The same sequence with min_loop 0: more ways to place the same number of pairs.

traces.title: RNA: wobble on
traces.description: G-U wobble pairs allowed.

traces.title: RNA: wobble off
traces.description: The same sequence with Watson-Crick pairs only.

traces.title: RNA: two hairpins
traces.description: Two separate stem-loops side by side (a bifurcation).

traces.title: RNA: homopolymer stem
traces.description: A run of A's against a run of U's: the stem can register in several ways.

traces.title: RNA: many ties
traces.description: Four C's can pair with the G's on either side, so dozens of structures tie.

traces.title: Yeast tRNA-Phe vs its real cloverleaf
traces.description: Nussinov packs in more pairs than the real tRNA has, and recovers only some of the true ones: maximising pair count is not how RNA folds. Reference arcs are drawn below the line.
